rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an expanded blastocyst consistent with 3AB, with compact ICM and looser/sparser TE; minor overinterpretation of zona thinning and image detail limits a perfect score.
Integrates age, AMH, oocyte yield, sperm quality, endometrium, diagnosis, and prior miscarriage with embryo quality well, though it overemphasizes presumed PCOS despite no explicit diagnosis.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are notable inconsistencies and speculative detours, especially around AMH/PCOS interpretation and fresh transfer vs PGT-A discussion.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF principles and Gardner grading, but recommendations such as thrombophilia workup after a single miscarriage and protocol suggestions are somewhat speculative and not strongly guideline-based.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for proceeding with transfer and reviewing stimulation in future cycles, though some suggestions are broad and not tightly tailored to available evidence.
